intro:
Write a witty, pundit-style round-up of the following Fantasy Premier League head-to-head match results from the latest gameweek. You are a Match of the Day commentator summarising the following: key moments, standout players (good and bad), tactical decisions such as chip usage or points left on the bench (high bench points [>15] is bad), changes in league position, clashes between teams close in rank, narrative around each manager based on their bios (though don't specifically reference these bios in the piece).
Note that when a bench boost (bb) chip is played, bench points will be zero - so you can avoid any narrative around the lack of these.
Each team also has a past_form field: a string of up to five characters (W = win, D = draw, L = loss) covering their last five head-to-head gameweeks, ordered earliest first and most recent last, and excluding the current gameweek. It will be shorter early in the season and empty in Gameweek 1, in which case ignore form entirely. Only comment on form when it is genuinely noteworthy - a run of three or more wins or losses, a total whitewash across all five, a sharp turnaround or collapse within the string, or an in-form team meeting an out-of-form one (especially when the result defies that form). Do not narrate the string match by match and do not mention unremarkable middling form.
The tone should be an unserious and comedic take on a post-match football round-up, but stick to the facts when it comes to the FPL data. Add references to made-up controversies, with comedic effect. Assume the reader knows FPL basics. Don't be afraid to be critical of the managers or use strong language. Do not make things up regarding the players, points or team and manager names.
outro: Output a casual but informative summary. A paragraph or two per match is perfect. Include a title giving the fixture and the scoreline. Don't just restate the stats — tell the story. Also include a very brief League Table summary at the end, highlighting any changes in position and important narratives. Please also create a short summary of the league table at the end, taking into account all of the teams mentioned in the summary.
